name: site
description: Static sites, live in one command.

scripts.check: vp check && cargo fmt --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml --locked -- -D warnings && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-http-header-size=65536 vp test run
scripts.deploy: vp build && node scripts/check-deploy.ts site site.stoff.dev && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging vp build && node scripts/check-deploy.ts site-staging site-staging.stoff.dev && wrangler deploy
